SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE DATE(BUY_DATE) = CURDATE()) AS todayOrderCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE YEAR(BUY_DATE) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(BUY_DATE) = MONTH(CURDATE())) AS monthOrderCount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BUY_PRICE), 0) FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE DATE(BUY_DATE) = CURDATE()) AS todaySales,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BUY_PRICE), 0) FROM SHOP_BUY WHERE YEAR(BUY_DATE) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(BUY_DATE) = MONTH(CURDATE())) AS monthSales

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 9 DAY) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE dt < CURDATE() ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dr.dt, '%m/%d') AS label, IFNULL(SUM(b.BUY_PRICE), 0) AS totalSales, COUNT(b.BUY_NUM) AS orderCount FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN SHOP_BUY b ON DATE(b.BUY_DATE) = dr.dt GROUP BY dr.dt ORDER BY dr.dt ASC
SELECT B.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail, COUNT(B.BUY_NUM) AS orderCount, SUM(B.BUY_PRICE) AS totalSales FROM SHOP_BUY B GROUP BY B.MEM_EMAIL ORDER BY totalSales DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT BK.BOOK_NUM AS bookNum, BK.BOOK_TITLE AS bookTitle, BK.AUTHOR, SUM(D.BUY_CNT) AS totalQty FROM BUY_DETAIL D JOIN SHOP_BOOK BK ON D.BOOK_NUM = BK.BOOK_NUM GROUP BY BK.BOOK_NUM, BK.BOOK_TITLE, BK.BOOK_PRICE ORDER BY totalQty DESC LIMIT 5
